chunks: Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Sa'id ibn Aziz al-Samarqandi, the jurist in the land of Balkh, told us: He said, Abu Ahmad al-Zahid al-Samarqandi, with his chain, ascribed it to al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)

A man asked him and said to him: Indeed, the foundation of the religion is Monotheism and Justice, and its knowledge is abundant, and a rational person must have it. So, mention what can be easily stood upon and is attainable to memorize? He said: As for Monotheism, it is to proclaim as impossible upon your Lord that which is possible upon you, and as for Justice, it is to not attribute to your Creator that which He has blamed you for.

key_terms.وَالْعَدْلُ: And Justice, divine equity and fairness

ai.seo_question: What are the definitions of Monotheism and Justice according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) encapsulates the core of Shia theological rationalism, defining Tawhid as the negation of human limitations in the Divine and Adl as the absence of unjust blame in God. It serves as a concise epistemological key for understanding the attributes of God, emphasizing that divine perfection precludes the imperfections found in creation. This definition aligns with the Usuli school's reliance on reason ('aql) to derive theological truths directly from the nature of the Divine.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Abu’l-Hasan, Muhammed bin Sa’eed bin Aziz al-Samarqandi, the jurist – in the land of Balkh – that he said: We were told by Abu Ahmad, Zahid al-Samarqandi, with his chain of narrators, that he ascribed to al-Sadiq, peace be upon him,

that a man asked him, to which he said: Indeed, the foundation of the religion is Monotheism and Justice, and its knowledge is abundant, and a rational person must have it. So, mention what can be easily stood upon and is attainable to memorize? Then he, peace be upon him, said: As for Monotheism, it is to proclaim as impossible upon your Lord that which is possibly upon you, and as for Justice, it is to not attribute to your Creator that which He has blamed you for.
